$comment: GENERATED by engine/src/ledger_engine/protocol/schema.py from the engine's message models (ADR-0054). Do not edit: run `engine/.venv/bin/python -I -m ledger_engine.protocol.schema > contracts/engine-protocol.schema.json`.
title: Finzytrack engine protocol
description: The plain-data protocol between the main sidecar and the ledger engine. JSON Lines: one request per line on the engine's stdin, one reply per line on its protocol channel (its original stdout; stray output inside the engine goes to stderr). UTF-8, at most x-max-line-bytes per line without the newline. Every message carries `v` (x-protocol-version), `id` and `op`; a reply adds `ok` and `result` or `error`, and may carry the engine's `decision`. `handshake` comes first. One request is answered before the next is read. Before its reply a request may send job messages with its `id` and `op`: progress (any number), `gate` (at most once; the engine then reads nothing but the sidecar's `proceed` for this request) and `committed` (only after `proceed`).

CommittedEvent.description: The save landed: its closed record is durable (engine-jobs §6.1 step 9).
CommittedEvent.title: CommittedEvent

Control.description: A line the sidecar sends that is not a request (it gets no reply).

Decision.description:
An engine decision, for the decision log (engine-jobs §12): the table and its version, its inputs and its
output. Content-free: the inputs are flat scalars (counts, which check failed, hash equalities), never a path, a
file name, an amount or a hash value; the engine is responsible for that, the shape keeps nesting out.
Decision.title: Decision

EntrySeen.description: An entry as it stands: its kind, and for a regular file its SHA-256 and size.
EntrySeen.title: EntrySeen

GateEvent.description: The job reached its commit point and waits for `proceed` (engine-jobs §4, §6.1 step 7).
GateEvent.title: GateEvent

HandshakeResult.description: What the engine is: the protocol it speaks and the versions that shape its answers.
HandshakeResult.title: HandshakeResult

InspectedFile.description: What stands at one file of a stopped journal now, and its kept copies (§11: Show both, Show it).
InspectedFile.title: InspectedFile

JobEvent.description: A job message the engine sends before its reply.

JournalFile.description: One file a journal names: its canonical path, its `path_key`, and whether the save was creating it.
JournalFile.title: JournalFile

ListedJournal.description:
An `.open` record found by the listing. `readable` False: it names nothing it can be matched on (torn,
foreign, newer, of another name, or a read error: `errno`), so it blocks every open (ADR-0063).
ListedJournal.title: ListedJournal

NoParams.description: An op that takes no parameters.
NoParams.title: NoParams

PingResult.description: The engine is up and reading requests.
PingResult.title: PingResult

ProceedControl.description: The sidecar's answer to a gate: go past the commit point (engine-jobs §4).
ProceedControl.title: ProceedControl

ProgressEvent.description: The job's phase changed (engine-jobs §5.4: shown, never judged).
ProgressEvent.title: ProgressEvent

R4AttemptResult.description: `r4_attempt`: `gone`, `counted`, or `could_not_check` (the third: the record is now `.mismatch`).
R4AttemptResult.title: R4AttemptResult

R4CheckResult.description:
`r4_check` (steps 1-3): `gone` (the record is not `.closed`), `unreadable`, `superseded`, `superseded_build`,
`pass`, or `differs` (the confirm is next).
R4CheckResult.title: R4CheckResult

R4ResumeResult.description:
`r4_resume` (Resume saving): `done` (the `.mismatch` record is now `.done`) or `gone` (it was not
`.mismatch`).
R4ResumeResult.title: R4ResumeResult

RecoverActParams.description:
A blocked-screen action on one `.open` journal (§8.1 "Afterwards", §11): `keep`; `delete_kept` (`file`, the
kept copy's entry name `kept`, and the `sha256` the user was shown); `delete_created` (`file`, `sha256`).
RecoverActParams.title: RecoverActParams

RecoverListParams.description: `app_local_data`: the app's machine-local folder; the journals are in its `local/<key>/journal/`.
RecoverListParams.title: RecoverListParams

RecoverListResult.description: §8.1: every `.open` journal after a `durable_sync` of each journal folder; `.part` records removed.
RecoverListResult.title: RecoverListResult

RecoverTryResult.description:
One journal's try (§8.1 steps 1-4): `resolved`, `stopped` (blocking reason `stopped`) or `failed` (reason
`failed`), with the cause, the file (`path`), the entry that failed or blocked when it is not the file, the
blocking ACL entry (`detail`; for a `foreign` stop, `empty`: the file is empty on a drive without the swap and its
backup holds the old version, S0065) and the error number; for `stopped`, what stands there now (`inspection`).
RecoverTryResult.title: RecoverTryResult

Refusal.description:
A refused request, or a line that was not a request. `id` and `op` are those of the request when it could
be read that far, else null; `op` is null too when it cannot be echoed exactly (not valid Unicode, or longer
than 128 characters).
Refusal.title: Refusal

SaveChange.description:
One file the save writes: its path as the ledger names it, the SHA-256 of its bytes in the plan (null: the save
creates it), and its new text (a ledger file is UTF-8 text; whole files until the contract's edits, BL-0106).
SaveChange.title: SaveChange

SaveOutcomeParams.description: §6.6: the save `session`-`job` of workspace `workspace_key`, whose engine ended without its final reply.
SaveOutcomeParams.title: SaveOutcomeParams

SaveOutcomeResult.description:
The record's state after its folder's sync (`unknown`: it could not be read; `errno`), and with no record, a
`.part` or `.resolved`, whether every target equals its pre bytes (`unchanged`; `path`: the first that does not).
SaveOutcomeResult.title: SaveOutcomeResult

SaveParams.description:
A confirmed plan (§2's `save`): who saves (`session`, `job`, the workspace's registry key and lineage id), the
ledger's root, the changes, the plan's fingerprint (`ledger_set.encode`'s text), the published mirror's
fingerprint digest (null: none), the legacy locks to try (ADR-0062) and the app's machine-local folder.
SaveParams.title: SaveParams

SaveResult.description:
How the save ended (§6.1, §11). `saved`: the closed record is durable (`published`: the mirror was published,
never yet, BL-0113). `refused`: before the commit point, nothing written (`reason`: `unfinished_save`,
`check_pending`, `check_failed`, `legacy_app_saving`, `ledger_changed`, `mirror_stale`, `load_refused`).
`not_saved`: the writer's `NotSaved` (`reason` its own: `hard_linked`, `locked`, `not_a_file`, `permission`,
`changed`, `path_moved`, `read_back`, `io_error`, `name_not_utf8`; `open_journal`: writes are
paused until recovery). `unfinished`: a file may have been replaced and the rollback stopped (`cause`, and
`cause_path` its file: after `created_path_taken` the undo will ask about that file). `unchanged`: every file the
save would write was hashed again and equals its pre bytes. `path`: the file it is about; `entry`: the folder a
`permission` refusal is about, `detail`: the ACL entry that blocks it. For `check_pending` and `check_failed`,
`path` is the record (S0066: the sidecar runs a `.closed` record's R4 and asks again); for `check_failed`,
`backup` is the paused save's backup folder (None when its record cannot be read) and `could_not_check` whether
its R4 failed to run three times.
SaveResult.title: SaveResult

UnlistedFolder.description: A journal folder that could not be synced, opened or listed: it blocks every open.
UnlistedFolder.title: UnlistedFolder
